scenes.say: Chemist owners. Aapka customer app se dawai mangwa raha hai?

scenes.text: *Parchi ki photo*, ghar pe delivery. *Aap bhi* de sakte ho.
scenes.say: App ka fayda kya hai? Parchi ki photo, aur ghar pe delivery. Ye aap bhi de sakte ho.

scenes.title: 1. *WhatsApp order*:
scenes.name: Your Medical Store

msgs.text: Sab available ✅ Total *₹640* (10% off). 45 min mein delivery. *UPI ya cash?*

scenes.say: Parchi ki photo aayi, do minute mein total, discount aur delivery time.

scenes.title: 2. Isko *system* banao:
scenes.say: Counter pe QR, har bill pe number save, aur monthly dawai pe refill reminder.

scenes.text: Aap *mohalle ke* ho. *45 min*, app se pehle.
scenes.say: Aapka asli fayda. Aap mohalle ke ho. Pain taalees minute, app se pehle.
Comment karo ORDER, setup checklist bhejenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.

caption:
Mohalle ka customer ab app se dawai mangwata hai. Par app ke paas ek hi cheez hai jo aapke paas nahi: "parchi ki photo bhejo, ghar aa jayega". 💊

Business of the Day: Pharmacy
